author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a stick figure with tiny dot fists (read as a dancer or juggler); redrawn toward the reference's three-quarter guard pose: round head over a rounded left shoulder, one big glove held in front of the chest with its forearm dropping, and the other glove raised high on the right with the shoulder line rising to it and its forearm forming the body's right edge.
omissions: Glove cuffs/thumbs and the bent upper arm omitted (8-unit clearance); gloves drawn as r5 rounds.
